scope.claim: V2-thickened-rib is the recommended prototype variant; V1 is modal-marginal and V3 is disqualified.
claimed: V2 clears safety factor against yield with SF = 8.15 under the e-stop load case.
V2 clears the 35 Hz servo-loop modal target with loaded f1 = 39.6 Hz.
The relative ranking is robust to the known Tet4 bending limitation.

limitation: Tet4 elements can under-predict bending deflection by 10-30%; upgrade to Tet10 and experimental correlation before production signoff.
